detail.longDescription:
The mobile companion app for your Commissions Inc agent account.  Manage your leads on the go, and quickly get in touch with your home seekers.

Features:
-Lead push notifications so you can instantly get in contact with new buyers
-View all of your leads and 1-touch to view details 
-Call, Text, and Email your leads right from the app
-Mass messaging capability
-Search for properties for and share properties directly in the App
-Manage Plan Tasks
-Edit/Create saved searches
-Filter and sort to manage leads
-Keyword search to find leads 
-Add lead notes and reminders that instantly sync with your agent dashboard
-Ability to add a new lead
-Organize by labels
